| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Filter strength** `h` | 25.5 | 1 to 100 levels | The cut-off distance h of the patch weights. scikit-image uses 0.1 of the range, which is 25.5 levels. |
| **Noise sigma** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 100 levels | The standard deviation of the noise, if you know it. Above 0, scikit-image subtracts the expected noise from the patch distances. scikit-image uses 0. |
| **Patch size** `patchSize` | 7 | 3 to 15 px | The side of the square patches that are compared. scikit-image uses 7. |
| **Search distance** `patchDistance` | 11 | 1 to 30 px | How far from the pixel, in each direction, patches are searched. scikit-image uses 11. |
| **Fast mode** `fastMode` | on | On or off | The fast mode of Darbon et al. weighs every pixel of a patch the same. Off, scikit-image weighs the patch with a Gaussian, as Buades, Coll and Morel did. scikit-image uses the fast mode. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
